---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new engine, filter, fetcher, or report feature
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Summary

What feature would you like to see?

## Use case

What are you trying to accomplish that this feature would unlock?

## Proposed API

Sketch the CLI flag, Python API, config key, or output format you'd like.
If you have a reference implementation or sketch (even pseudo-code), attach it.

## Alternatives considered

What other ways could you accomplish this today? Why aren't they enough?

## Willingness to contribute

- [ ] I'm willing to open a PR for this
- [ ] I'd need help implementing it
- [ ] Just a suggestion

## Additional context

Anything else (links to upstream issues, similar projects, etc.).
